source_claim: Nintendo’s official product page identifies Etrian Odyssey 2 Untold: The Fafnir Knight and names Arianna, princess of the Duchy of Caledonia, as the story’s protected character. This directly establishes the tagged Arianna Caledonia identity in the Etrian Odyssey franchise.
notes: Only Arianna Caledonia is explicitly established in the checked official product page; other Etrian Odyssey campaign identities are omitted.
